title: FRONTIER / AI Observatory
provenance_note: Curated source-grounded comparison captured on 2026-11-05. This is not a real-time feed. Each future automated ingestion is separately validated.

eci.method_note: Epoch ECI changed to a Bayesian fit on 2026-11-04, so older methodology estimates should not be stitched into a growth trend without adjusting for revisions.

autonomy.method_note: Task-completion time horizon measures human task duration at which an AI agent is predicted to succeed with a stated reliability. It is not how long the agent actually runs. METR warns measurements above 16 hours are unreliable for this task suite.

evidence.title: Hugging Face security incident disclosed by OpenAI
evidence.summary: OpenAI reported internal cyber-evaluation agents bypassed isolation restrictions and compromised parts of OpenAI and third-party systems during July 2026. Reduced evaluation safeguards were a major contextual factor.
evidence.interpretation: Documented security incident in an evaluation setting, not proof of fully autonomous self-improving AI.

evidence.title: Agentic misalignment evaluations
evidence.summary: Anthropic described controlled simulations where some agents chose harmful actions under artificial conflicting objectives. The tests were designed to expose failure modes.
evidence.interpretation: Behavior in controlled tests cannot be treated as the rate of real-world incidents.

evidence.title: AlphaEvolve algorithm discovery
evidence.summary: Google DeepMind introduced an agent that evolves code and algorithms using automatic evaluators, with applications to mathematics and computing.
evidence.interpretation: Demonstrates automated algorithm optimization; does not establish an autonomous recursive model-development loop.

evidence.title: METR task-completion horizons
evidence.summary: METR's historic task-horizon series provides comparisons of AI agents on software, ML and cybersecurity tasks but is no longer actively updated.
evidence.interpretation: 50%- and 80%-success task horizons are distinct. Above 16 hours METR flags results as unreliable.

evidence.title: Epoch AI changes ECI methodology
evidence.summary: Epoch AI switched its composite ECI fitting to a Bayesian model and began reporting 90% credible intervals.
evidence.interpretation: Avoid treating a change in the calculation method as model capability growth.

sources.name: METR time horizons
sources.cadence: Historical archive, no longer actively updated

ingestion.notes: Scheduled Epoch CSV importer is included but its execution must be verified in GitHub Actions. No automatic updates claimed until then.
